description: This file contains SwiftUI view components for rendering and editing channel configuration schemas within a macOS application. It defines structures for dynamic form generation based on JSON schema-like data models, allowing user interaction with various data types such as object, array, boolean, number, and string.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaForm
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that dynamically renders a form based on a configuration schema and current store state.

classes.name: ChannelConfigForm
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for displaying channel-specific configuration schemas, utilizing ConfigSchemaForm.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a schema node into a SwiftUI view based on its type and properties.

methods.name: renderStringField
methods.description: Renders a text input, SecureField, or Picker for string-based schema properties.

methods.name: renderNumberField
methods.description: Renders a number input field, handling both integer and floating-point types.

methods.name: renderArray
methods.description: Renders a list of items with add/remove controls, based on array schema.

methods.name: renderAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Renders dynamic additional key-value entries beyond predefined schema properties.

methods.name: stringBinding
methods.description: Creates a two-way binding for string schema values.

methods.name: boolBinding
methods.description: Creates a two-way binding for boolean schema values.

methods.name: numberBinding
methods.description: Creates a two-way binding for number schema values as strings for input fields.

methods.name: enumBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for enum options, represented as integers for Picker selection.

methods.name: mapKeyBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for dictionary keys in additional properties entries.
